note: Boards: design/design_handoff_custom_auth/boards/03-google (google-busy-m, google-cancelled-m, google-refused-m, google-refused-d) and 05-sign-up (Google under the form). Signed out; the dev server runs with NEXT_PUBLIC_PUBLIC_BROWSE=true so /sign-up/new needs no invite cookie. Photographed without asking Clerk anything: the start screen with Google, the cancelled note and the refused card (both are the start screen with ?google=), and the sign-up form with Google under it. The refused card does not name the Google address (the board does): Clerk does not hand the address back when the transfer is refused, and the card needs none. Hand-walked on staging, because no sheet can complete a Google round trip: the busy state, Google back and signing in, a cancelled return, a Google account with no account here (refused, and no account made), the consent-return fallback, and a Google sign-up carrying legalAccepted.
